effect: The cell combination produced a lasting partnership and completed the remaining goal; its explanation identifies endosymbiosis as a compressed account, not a full origin of complex cells.

mostWorthwhile.text: Making banded iron connected oxygen production to a geological record and explained why atmospheric oxygen accumulated later.

leastWorthwhile.text: The rusted seabed was a fairly thin intermediate result on its own, with the useful explanation arriving only after the next combination.

surprise.text: The final cell pairing led to endosymbiosis and mitochondria rather than the coexistence I expected.

arbitrary.text: Combining two broadly named cell types did not clearly suggest a lasting partnership beforehand; it was also the only available combination.

continue.text: Yes. The oxygen crisis and the refuge for oxygen-free microbes made me curious about how a changing world supports different forms of life.
